name: multi-site-quant-research
why: Second prototype, higher complexity: two sites, a real OAuth gate, three sequential prompts, a clear-all between sets, and extraction from both surfaces. Tests everything the one-site run did plus sequencing and state reset.

login.entry: Login button, bottom-left of the page
login.gate: class-2 approval. Choosing an existing Google session is a click; typing a password, a 2FA code, or creating an account is NOT permitted — park in PAUSED_NEEDS_HUMAN

sites.login: already signed in in this Chrome profile (verified 2026-11-22)

prompts.text: List the trading strategies with the strongest documented out-of-sample evidence across asset classes — risk premia, time-series momentum, cross-sectional momentum, trend following, mean reversion, carry, volatility risk premium. For each: the canonical academic source, the asset classes where it replicated, the sample period, and the specific way it fails. Be explicit about what 'proven' can and cannot mean for a retail trader.

What metrics does a professional quant check before trusting a backtest? Give the exact statistic and a decision threshold for each: Sharpe, deflated Sharpe / DSR, PBO via CSCV, walk-forward efficiency, turnover, capacity and market impact, slippage sensitivity (2x cost test), information ratio vs a matched benchmark, max drawdown and recovery, tail ratio, hit rate vs payoff. Which single check kills the most strategies, and why?

Design a forward-test protocol that proves a strategy works without risking live money: pre-registration requirements, paper-trading fill assumptions, sample size and power calculation, stopping rules, multiple-testing correction across many strategies, and the specific evidence that would falsify the strategy. Include what most retail forward tests get wrong.

sequence: arena: open, login (Google, zerounderscore@gmail.com), run p1..p3, extract, clear all
chatplayground: open (already signed in), run p1..p3 to all panels, wait for every 'finished responding', extract, clear all

extraction.chatplayground: prototype/extract.py rebuilds the paste-all doc from the AX tree; per-panel 'Copy message' is the clipboard fallback
extraction.arena: no known paste-all yet — discover the per-answer copy controls on first run and record them in prototype/transcripts/
extraction.verify: every panel/section must be non-empty and name its model; a partial sweep is recorded as UNFINISHED, never smoothed over

reset.control: Clear all (broom icon) in the composer toolbar — click between prompt sets so answers never mix
reset.verify: the transcript column shows the empty state ('Ready when you are' / 'Message every model') before the next prompt is sent

cost_note: each prompt fans out to every selected model and spends credits; 3 prompts x 3 panels x 2 sites is the budget for this run
